inputRootSignature: theorem gumbel_approximation_to_exponential_maximum {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P) (hX_law : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) id P (expMeasure 1)) : let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩ let hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty := ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_univ i₀⟩ let M : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ Finset.univ.sup' hne (fun i ↦ X i ω) sSup (Set.range fun x : ℝ ↦ |ENNReal.toReal (P {ω | M ω - Real.log (n : ℝ) ≤ x}) - Real.exp (-Real.exp (-x))|) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)
